title: Kripal's levitation talk to Lockheed engineers

tellings.quote: Rice University. On the Danny Jones podcast, he revealed that Charles Chase, director of Lockheed's revolutionary projects organization, once invited him to give a private talk to top engineers on one topic, levitation.

related.note: Kripal speaking on levitation or flying saints to a Lockheed revolutionary-technology head. This is the same subject as the story of the levitation talk to Lockheed engineers, but here it is a public MIT lecture the head attended, not a private talk he asked for.

plain: Charles Chase, director of Lockheed's revolutionary projects organization at the Skunk Works, Lockheed's secretive advanced aircraft division, is said to have invited a Rice University scholar named Jeffrey Kripal to give a private talk to top engineers on one subject: levitation. Michels passes this on from what Kripal said on another interview show, hosted by Danny Jones. If true, it would mean that serious aerospace engineers took an interest in old accounts of people rising off the ground.
